[Followup from Sourceforge Tracker]
Followup Submitter: pangloss
Logged In: YES
user_id=487398
Originator: YES

I've marked the latest stable/recommended release where possible. I haven't made it through the entire list yet, however. Please contribute and fill in details where possible. In particular, it would be desirable to identify what look like problematic or easy upgrades and what libraries we might be able to prune from the next release.
